GrLivArea.reason: Numerical continuous. Right-skewed distribution with a few outliers on the higher x-axis end. Clipping at 3600 removes outliers that only add noise.

GarageCars.reason: Ordinal. Linear relationship from x=0 to x=3, price drop at x=4 (only 5 values in total). Clipping at 3 preserves linear trend.

Id.reason: Unique identifier with no predictive power.

TotalBsmtSF.reason: Continuous. Right-skewed, clip due to extreme anomaly at +6000. Add flag to help the model learn the difference between houses with/without basement.
